paper_title: Search for QCD coupled axion dark matter with the MICROSCOPE space experiment
notes: Paper constrains the QCD axion-gluon coupling 1/f_a (Peccei-Quinn scale) via UFF/equivalence-principle violation from MICROSCOPE. Exclusion plot (Fig. 2) has y-axis 1/f_a [GeV^-1] vs axion mass m_a [eV], covering ~1e-20 to ~1e-13 eV. Only two endpoint values are explicitly quoted in text: 1/f_a ~1.7e-16 GeV^-1 at m_a=1e-20 eV and 1/f_a ~1.3e-10 GeV^-1 at m_a~7.7e-14 eV; the full curve has structure (bands, sign changes) not extractable from text. The axion-gluon coupling induces CP-odd effects, so AxionCPV is used, but note the emitted values are 1/f_a in GeV^-1, NOT the standard dimensionless AxionCPV coupling — downstream conversion should account for this.
